_provenance.why_subset: RAGAS costs ~300 judge calls over the full 21-query set -- 20x our entire Dimension 3 -- because it decomposes every claim against every context. Measured 2-4 hours; a 4-query subset covering each behaviour (research, adverse, enumerative, point-lookup) buys the cross-check for ~15 minutes.
_provenance.faithfulness_method: segment-wise: the answer is split on entry boundaries and every segment scored, because Azure's content filter blocks the judge's own output on full-length answers containing fatal-accident detail. All 4 queries reached 100% segment coverage.
